xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4837: Phone app: apps/mobile Capacitor app with sign-in, machines, pairing and the phone screens

plan.title: Phone app: apps/mobile Capacitor app with sign-in, machines, pairing and the phone screens
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The PWA phone screens reach a machine only over Tailscale. Epic PAN-4823 adds a native iOS and Android app that reaches machines through the overdeck.ai directory and an end-to-end encrypted channel. Its prerequisites (contracts, directory client role, native sign-in redirect, the channel package with HTTP/WebSocket shims, the phone credential and the Settings QR) are merged; the app itself does not exist.
narratives.Proposal: Create apps/mobile: a Vite build of a small React shell plus the existing /m phone screens, wrapped by Capacitor 8 (ai.overdeck.app). The shell signs in with PKCE through the system browser and native HTTP, lists the directory machines, pairs by QR or ai.overdeck.app:/pair link through a pairing-mode channel with a fresh per-machine link key, and renders MobileApp for the current machine with every /api and /ws request routed through installChannelShims. A Java and a Swift OverdeckKeys plugin hold the client id, the push key pair and the secrets. The frontend gains a native shell mode that skips the session/CSRF bootstrap and PWA chrome and hides admin-only controls. CI builds the Android debug APK. Acceptance is the epic AC-10 run on the Android emulator, plus CP-1 (iOS Simulator), CP-3 and CP-4 measurements. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4837.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Push registration, the iOS Notification Service Extension, Keychain Sharing and App Groups (PAN-4838).
- The iOS Live Activity (PAN-4839) and the Android FCM messaging service (PAN-4840).
- Store listings, signing, release builds, Firebase and APNs setup (PAN-4841).
- User-facing docs pages such as configuration/phone-app.mdx (PAN-4842).
- The machine-side native push provider (PAN-4843).
- Reaching linked machines through the paired machine, including /api/fleet/needs-you for phones (PAN-4887).
- Any new route-scopes.ts row or machine-side route change.
- Over-the-air updates of the app code.
- A Content-Security-Policy meta tag.
- Notification and Live Activity switches in Settings.
- iOS camera verification (the Simulator has no camera).
- App icons, splash artwork and store branding (PAN-4841).
- Any behavior change to the desktop dashboard or the PWA outside isNativeShell() branches.

autoDecisions.summary: Link keys are generated per paired machine in JavaScript (generateStaticKeyPair), not returned by the native plugin.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4835 D-2 requires a fresh link key per pairing (the exchange answers 409 for a reused key), which contradicts the epic single linkSecretKeyHex; the link secret enters JavaScript in both designs because the Noise handshake runs there.

autoDecisions.summary: hello-client publicKeyHex carries the push public key.
autoDecisions.rationale: With per-machine link keys the push key is the only install-level X25519 key; the directory stores the field and uses it for nothing else today.

autoDecisions.summary: iOS key generation uses CryptoKit Curve25519; Android uses lazysodium with a BouncyCastle fallback; the Android plugin is Java.
autoDecisions.rationale: swift-sodium needs a Swift package reference hand-edited into project.pbxproj on Linux; CryptoKit keys are byte-compatible with libsodium. The Capacitor 8 Android template has no Kotlin toolchain and MYN app-local plugins are Java.

autoDecisions.summary: iOS secrets stay in the default Keychain access group; Keychain Sharing moves to PAN-4838.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic assigns the Keychain Sharing capability to W-IOS1, and an unsigned Simulator build cannot use a shared access group.

autoDecisions.summary: Scaffold dependencies trimmed to core, cli, ios, android, app and browser.
autoDecisions.rationale: push-notifications arrives with PAN-4838/4840; status-bar, splash-screen and haptics have no caller in this issue (Karpathy simplicity).

autoDecisions.summary: Switching machines stores the choice and reloads the page.
autoDecisions.rationale: A reload gives the RPC transport, React Query cache and Zustand stores a clean start with no reset code added to the frontend.

autoDecisions.summary: Settings has no notification or Live Activity switch in this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those switches have no behavior until PAN-4838/4839/4840.

autoDecisions.summary: Account and directory base URLs are build-time configurable via VITE_OVERDECK_ACCOUNT_URL and VITE_OVERDECK_DIRECTORY_URL.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the CLI OVERDECK_ACCOUNT_URL and directory_url and lets the app run against a staging stack while production lacks PAN-4831.

autoDecisions.summary: The account service is called through CapacitorHttp (native HTTP).
autoDecisions.rationale: services/account sends no CORS headers, so a WebView fetch from capacitor://localhost to /oauth/token is blocked.

autoDecisions.summary: The mobile-android CI job is added to the test aggregator (blocking).
autoDecisions.rationale: Frontend changes can break the app bundle and only CI would catch it; the gradle cache bounds flake risk.

autoDecisions.summary: No Content-Security-Policy meta in this issue; deferred to the release issue PAN-4841.
autoDecisions.rationale: The app loads only bundled code and markdown is sanitized; a CSP must list build-time base URLs and belongs with release hardening.

autoDecisions.summary: apps/mobile/README.md is created here; PAN-4842 adds release and user documentation.
autoDecisions.rationale: The developer README documents the build this issue creates; the user pages are PAN-4842 scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Admin-only controls are hidden (or their reads skipped) behind isNativeShell() in three items, not tolerated as 403s.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4835 D-7 lets W-APP1 hide or tolerate; hiding avoids 60 s and 5 s 403 polls and dead buttons, and the trace found every site.

autoDecisions.summary: MIN_PAN_VERSION is the first tag containing the PAN-4835 merge, else the next minor after the root package version (0.74.0 today).
autoDecisions.rationale: No release contains PAN-4835 yet; NFR-6 needs a concrete minimum version in the outdated message.

metadata.sizeJustification: W-APP1 is one child issue of the PAN-4823 epic whose acceptance (AC-10) is a single end-to-end run: sign in, pair, Needs you, answer, send. The surface spans the new apps/mobile workspace (web shell plus generated native projects), two small package additions, native-shell branches in the frontend, one CI job and one server test. Splitting further would ship an app that cannot sign in or cannot render the screens, which no reviewer or UAT run could verify on its own. The 28 items keep each diff small and the DAG lets independent items run in parallel.
